stages.summary: Stronger and more expensive version of the CoC Comet setup.

general_advice.text: League start as Spark Stormweaver, farm core pieces, then swap into CoC Comet once gear and Spirit are ready.
general_advice.quote: You can league start as Spark, farm your core pieces, then swap into CoC Comet once your gear and Spirit setup are ready.

general_advice.text: Reach 181 Spirit for Cast on Critical plus Mana Remnants, Siphon Elements and Convalescence.
Solve mana with Efficiency II on all gems, a Conservative Casting anoint, Mana Remnants, and mana regen gear.
general_advice.quote:
Efficiency II
on all skill gems, anoint
Conservative Casting
on amulet,

general_advice.text: Use Zenith II on damage spells once mana cost allows it.
general_advice.quote:
Zenith II
will also help reduce mana cost and you should put this on all your damage spells if your mana cost gets solved with it.

general_advice.text: Use Mana Tempest proactively before dangerous encounters.
general_advice.quote: Mana Tempest should be used proactively. Do not wait until the situation is already bad.

general_advice.text: On pinnacle bosses, preload Sigil of Power and Elemental Weakness before the boss becomes vulnerable.
general_advice.quote: For pinnacle bosses, your goal is to preload as much damage as possible before the boss becomes vulnerable.

general_advice.text: Anoint Climate Change if mana is not an issue.

warnings.text: Don't build around many weak Comets on trash; let Spark/Orb clear and keep Comet strong for tough targets.
warnings.quote: Do not build around making hundreds of weak Comets fall on every small monster.

warnings.text: Not a face-tank build; defense comes from freeze, range and killing enemies first.
warnings.quote: This is not a face-tank build.
Do not try and copy my jewels exactly, because I was just going off a list of good mods and getting something with 4 of them.

warnings.text: Visual clarity can be poor in boss fights.
warnings.quote: Visual clarity can be difficult in boss fights
